TOOLING BURST T4x — rendered-look corrections from the PACK v30 in-scene look (Run C-5, E3; conductor R-C5-74, defects F-C5-16/17/18/19). task_id "T4x". Specs are conductor-authored; the NEW values below are the conductor's re-authoring — apply them to the named spec files and re-bake the named kits; report any value the runtime cannot honour.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4h (burst_v2 clauses), T4s (r2/r3), T4u, T4v, T4w (+ runs/C-5/t3/T4w/acceptance.json unhonourable_fields — the proof) and the new row "T4x — rendered-look corrections (Concoction cloud, Healing Hands seal + ring, Frozen Orb nova)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (G4 aura component: _bind, the Seal rotation line `$Ground/Seal.rotation = TAU*float(age)/480.0`, the Ring segment orbit; G2 field component: field_scale, the breathe/density alpha lines, DarkDuplicate; G1 orb: expiry / pieces burst_v1r), export/effect_kit.py (g4 keys, G2 density, orb block, pieces templates), runs/C-5/specs/healing_hands.json, runs/C-5/specs/poisonous_concoction.json, runs/C-5/specs/frozen_orb.json, the three kits under runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/ (healing_hands_e3, poisonous_concoction_e3, frozen_orb_e3), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART D — FIRST: HEADLESS HANG REGRESSION SINCE T4w (conductor-measured outside the sandbox). After T4v the outside suite had these green; after T4w they time out (60 s in the test; the conductor re-ran the E2 fixture by hand: `--import` exits 0 in 3 s, then `--script res://e2_probe.gd` prints only the Godot banner and is still running at 300 s): tests/test_vfx_picker.py IceTreatmentPickerTests.test_headless_contact_shatter_residue_decal and TouchAimRuntimeTests.test_headless_overlay_forward_world_touch_and_mouse_probe. FrozenOrbPickerTests.test_headless_orb_clock_and_pool COMPLETES (it fails only on the old every-2 emission ages — realign it to the kit's own schedule, Part C0). Suspect: the G1 component's clock after the `config.schedule.emission_ages` change (T4w) on NON-orb G1 kits (fire/ice bolts have no orb schedule) — an expiry or emission loop that never advances, so the probe never reaches its quit condition. Diagnose with the two tests (they build their own fixtures), fix the runtime so every G1 kit's cast terminates as before, and add a headless regression clause: each of the two probes exits 0 within 60 s. Do this BEFORE Parts A–C; if it cannot be fixed inside the budget, return FAILED with the diagnosis — Parts A–C are worthless on a runtime that hangs.

PART A — HEALING HANDS (F-C5-17 seal, F-C5-18 ring). (A1) The seal primitive is PAINTED as a perspective ellipse; `_bind` scales it uniformly and the loop spins it by node rotation, so at 90° (age 120) the painted ellipse stands upright. Fix in transform order, not in the painting: measure the seal texture's alpha-bbox aspect a = h/w once at bake (record it in the kit: `seal_aspect`); the Seal sprite gets scale (s, s/a) (un-squash to a circle) and carries the spin; its PARENT (a new `SealPivot` Node2D under Ground, or Ground itself if nothing else there needs a different squash) gets scale (1, a). Result: the drawn seal keeps aspect a at every age. Trace clause: for ages 0..duration in steps of 12, the seal's drawn bbox aspect stays within ±5 % of a; the y-sort/z rules of T4s-r2 unchanged. (A2) Ring: new spec values — mechanics.radius_px 220 → 160; presentation.body_extents_bh.ring_diameter 3.4 → 2.46; segment sprite scale ×0.7 (primitives.ring.scale in the kit). Apply to runs/C-5/specs/healing_hands.json (keep every other field byte-for-byte; add provenance line "R-C5-74 F-C5-18") and re-bake healing_hands_e3 (pieces/primitives byte-identical apart from the ring scale value). Trace clause: every segment position within 160 ± 2 px (before the .58 y-squash) of the owner for the whole loop.

PART B — CONCOCTION CLOUD (F-C5-16): rendered as a flat opaque hard-edged single-tone puddle. Re-author (apply to runs/C-5/specs/poisonous_concoction.json presentation + kit; provenance "R-C5-74 F-C5-16"): ground_squash 0.58 → 0.72 (a cloud has height; the lobes rise); density 0.75 → 0.60 (Field alpha = density × breathe ⇒ peak ≈ 0.64, never opaque); edge erosion: Field material erode_noise 0.4 with the continuous whole-body noise texture (the burst_v2 rule, T4h) — a ragged rim, never a clean ellipse edge; roil: the Field's noise uv drifts at 0.05 texture-widths/s (a new g2 field key `roil_uv_per_s`, validated 0..0.2); dark rim: DarkDuplicate alpha 0.25 → 0.5 and offset +6 px down (a new key `dark_offset_px`, validated 0..12). Blackwater keeps ITS values (painted pool; do not touch its kit beyond a byte-identical re-export). Trace clause: Concoction Field modulate.a ≤ 0.64 at every age; the shader's erode parameter ≥ 0.3 while the field lives; DarkDuplicate offset recorded.

PART C0 — FROZEN ORB EMISSION CONTRACT, CORRECTED (T4w proved the conductor's {2,3} contract impossible: max CV 1/√24 ≈ 0.204; the proof is accepted, R-C5-75). New contract: per-emission intervals drawn from {2,3,4} frames as a SEEDED SHUFFLE OF A BALANCED MULTISET (equal counts of 2, 3 and 4, length ≥ the maximum emissions over the 90-frame flight, i.e. 45; take intervals in shuffled order until the flight ends) — CV of the drawn sequence is then ≈ 0.27 for every seed (assert ≥ 0.25 for seeds 2026, 2027, 1); emission count over the 90-frame flight in [26,34]; determinism as T4w (same seed equal, different seed differs). Orb-block key: `interval_frames_choices: [2,3,4]` + `interval_draw: "balanced_shuffle"` (validate: ≥ 2 distinct choices, all ≥ 1; draw ∈ {balanced_shuffle}). Apply to the spec (provenance "R-C5-75") and re-bake (masks byte-identical); realign FrozenOrbValidationTests.test_literal_spec_schedule_range_conflict_and_renamed_kit to this contract (interval_cv ≥ 0.25, ff08_satisfied TRUE, gaps ⊂ {2,3,4}, count in [26,34]).

PART C — FROZEN ORB NOVA EXPIRY (F-C5-19): the expiry currently plays the whole 3-BH crystal peak (burst_v1r hold + shatter + frost-crown decal) — an impact. D2's orb EXPIRES as a radial nova of bolts from a small core with nothing struck. New orb-block keys (validate them): `expiry_mode: "nova"` (vs the existing "peak"), `expiry_core_bh: 0.8` (0.4..1.2), `expiry_decal: false`. In nova mode: NO peak hold frames, NO frost-crown decal, NO residue; at the range point a 0.8-BH core flash (the P_ice_puff body at scale, 6 frames, fading) and the 16 shards (the existing motion groups) translate outward from the core at base_speed_px_s, oriented along velocity, erode over 0.5 s (burst_v2's outside-in rule). Apply `expiry_mode: nova` to the Frozen Orb spec (provenance "R-C5-74 F-C5-19") and re-bake; the 16 piece masks stay byte-identical. Trace clause: no frame in which the peak index is drawn whole; no Decal node visible at any age; 16 shard nodes with |position| increasing monotonically from the range point.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4x/acceptance.json): the four trace clauses above with numbers; specs and kits changed ONLY in the named fields (diff lists); the 14 other kits byte-identical; full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite: any test asserting the OLD values (seal rotation, radius 220, squash 0.58 — e.g. ThrownFieldPickerTests.test_thirteen_kits_registered_and_grammar_dispatch_explicit — density 0.75, expiry peak, every-2 emission ages) re-encoded from the CURRENT specs/kits (never a literal); remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the trace clauses; the new key validations (aspect recorded, roil range, dark_offset range, expiry_mode enum, expiry_core_bh range, interval_frames_choices / interval_draw); extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), any kit except the three named (+ byte-identical re-exports), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4x/, the three named spec files (named fields only) and the three kits. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4x"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
